resources.string: Full card: weekly limit, reset, and extra credits
One row: percent, bar, and credits
Drag between 1×1, 2×1, and 1×2. Same numbers in every size.
Allow notifications for Cursor Limits to use alerts
Sign in to your Cursor account.

The widget shows your weekly limit, reset time, and extra credits.

Sign in with the button. The session stays on this phone. Signing out of Cursor in the browser ends it.

Add a widget: long-press the home screen, then Widgets. Card and Wide are the large ones. Limits is the small one: drag it between 1×1, 2×1, and 1×2. The green number is the percent left and the gold number is extra credits, with no extra signs, in every size. 1×1 shows only the percent. The arrow refreshes. 1×1 opens the app.

Card and Wide can stretch to the full width of the screen. Hold the widget and drag a side handle. The numbers grow with the width and sit across the card, not against one edge.

Appearance changes this screen and every widget on the home screen.

Alerts fire once when the weekly percent left or the extra credits drop to the number you set. They can fire again after the number climbs back above it.

Android refreshes a widget at most every 15 minutes. Samsung may wait longer while the screen is off. In the app battery settings, choose Unrestricted.
